title: Mixed Event — Singing in Sync — Episode3 Dissonance

meta.Event Outline: As Vivid BAD SQUAD takes its first steps, An and Kohane are both fully confident that they have the best partner in one another. However, the two partners quickly find themselves hitting a snag. Will they be able to get through it?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I said I'd get Kohane back on track if anything happened, but I failed...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's my fault we messed up that song...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was too focused on working the crowd and missed my chance to back up Azusawa.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Who'd have thought we'd screw up like that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sigh... Just gotta make sure everything goes like clockwork next time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, you're all wrong...
It was all my fault.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I couldn't keep up and ended up throwing you off all your parts.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: No! Don't blame yourself, Kohane! That was your first battle event and I should've done more to help you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
No, you did all you could.
It was going so well... I'm really sorry, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I, um... I'll get us all something to drink.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It's my fault...
I should've helped her...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I failed as her partner... I couldn't protect her...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What do you mean by that?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, she's my partner... And I wanted to guide her so that she could sing without worrying...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I knew something was up. Now I get why what you said the other day didn't vibe with me.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You don't think of Kohane as one of the team.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You feel like you have to protect her...
Look after her.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: During our rehearsal, you talked about covering for her and getting her back on track, and thought that you were just trying to be helpful.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But what you really meant was that you saw her as someone who can't be one of us without your special help.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You don't see Kohane as a full-fledged member of our squad.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If you think you need to look after her, it means she's a helpless dependent in your eyes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(I couldn't protect her...
Even after saying that I'd help her.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: N-No.... But... That would mean that ever since we started this group, I wasn't being fair to her...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
The last group should be done by now.
Let's go back...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Was I not treating Kohane as an equal...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I kept telling her to be confident... That I'd cover for her as if she couldn't have done it without me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I... I have to apologize to her...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I have to tell her that I realized my mistake...!
